findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1453-1465 runs runStoryAwareDynamicValidation for observe mode, and packages/main/src/handlers/story-aware-validation.ts:325-366 launches Wave-0 plus selected commands. The same validate invocation then executes the complete plan at verifier.ts:1555-1565, so observe launches a competing validation plan and duplicates command/build side effects. The plan requires DYN-1 observe to instrument/compute selection while the unchanged complete plan remains the sole authority; gate observe to selection-only or attach instrumentation to the existing executor.

packages/main/src/handlers/story-aware-validation.ts:127-140 creates every closure from static inputRoots with producedBy=story-closure-preview, while packages/main/src/core/story-aware-validation.ts:355-385 only validates a caller-supplied ValidationRuntimeTrace. There is no runtime tracer or canonical-full-baseline compiler/call site: runStoryAwareDynamicValidation never supplies runtimeTraces, and the only references are the type and pure smoke tests. Undeclared file loads/spawns/environment reads therefore cannot invalidate a certificate, yet selection can admit a reuse receipt; this is the false-negative route explicitly closed by the plan and makes closure/reuse evidence unsafe.

packages/main/src/core/story-aware-validation.ts:787-819 only provides in-memory shard partition/aggregation helpers; rg shows no production caller outside story-aware-validation-smoke.ts and story-aware-validation-mutation-smoke.ts. The promised DYN-5 runtime assets (quorum-submit-shards.ts and review-pass-shards.ts), isolated command execution, durable shard/sentinel receipts, and cleanup/residue evidence are absent, so quorum/review-pass commands remain monolithic and the sharding safety/performance contract is not delivered.

packages/main/src/handlers/story-aware-validation.ts:396-413 hard-codes 10 of the 12 DYN-3 enforcement prerequisites to false and permits only RunStoryAwareValidationArgs.prerequisites to override them. The verifier call at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1454-1465 never supplies prerequisites, and rg finds no production provider of these trusted rows. Therefore --dynamic-mode=enforce-low-risk can never produce authoritative dynamic TEST evidence even after the replay/fault campaign; it always reports full-fallback. The implementation needs a gate-owned, current evidence reader/binding or must not claim the DYN-3 happy path is delivered.
